tests.name: test_nested_indefinite_text_string_cbor
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a nested indefinite-length text string in CBOR, ensuring it throws parse_error.113 instead of accepting it.

tests.name: test_nested_indefinite_binary_array_cbor
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a nested indefinite-length byte string in CBOR, ensuring it throws parse_error.113.

tests.name: test_valid_single_indefinite_text_string
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a valid single-level indefinite-length text string in CBOR to ensure it still parses correctly.

tests.name: test_valid_single_indefinite_binary_array
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a valid single-level indefinite-length byte string in CBOR to ensure it still parses correctly.

tests.name: test_deeply_nested_indefinite_text_strings
tests.intent: Probes parsing of a deeply nested indefinite-length text string sequence to ensure stack safety and immediate rejection.

tests.intent: Probes an indefinite text string with multiple valid chunks to confirm standard multi-chunk parsing behavior.

tests.name: test_indefinite_binary_with_multiple_definite_chunks
tests.intent: Probes an indefinite byte string with multiple valid chunks to confirm standard multi-chunk binary parsing behavior.

tests.name: test_mixed_type_indefinite_chunks

tests.intent: Probes an empty indefinite-length text string (just open and close markers).

tests.name: test_indefinite_string_utf8_check_after_break

tests.intent: Probes a nested indefinite string used as an object key in CBOR.

tests.name: test_multiple_nested_indefinite_binary_chunks
tests.intent: Probes multiple levels of nested indefinite-length binary arrays.

tests.intent: Probes the exact error message thrown by cbor_indefinite_string_error for string type.

tests.intent: Probes the exact error message thrown by cbor_indefinite_string_error for binary array type.

tests.intent: Probes nlohmann::ordered_json parsing of nested indefinite-length text strings in CBOR.
